style: Approved thin angular pale-cyan contours inspired by Cyberpunk 2077; fixed original HUD cell sizes.

prompts.swap: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: native pixel-game HUD pictogram. Reference image supplies ONLY the approved thin cyan contour style and one-logical-pixel stroke, not its wrench subject. Generate ONE different isolated glyph as described below. Match the reference Cyberpunk 2077-inspired angular minimalism, flat uniform pale cyan #9bbfc9, transparent background. Every visible contour should be ONE logical pixel wide on a coarse 16x16 logical grid (for larger clothing/hand use a 24x24 logical grid). Enlarge that tiny pixel art with nearest-neighbor to fill the output: crisp large square pixels, 90-degree lines and simple 45-degree stair steps. Keep a two-logical-pixel empty margin, open negative spaces, no solid filled silhouette, no frame, no words, no glow, gradients, antialiasing, texture, or tiny subpixel detail. Subject: Two thin horizontal arrows pointing in opposite directions, one above the other. Clean parallel shafts, open chevron arrowheads, clearly separated vertically.
